moves.name: Grapevine (Vine)
moves.description: Step to the side, cross the other foot behind, step to the side again, then tap/touch the first foot in. 4 counts, can go right or left.

moves.name: Rolling Grapevine (Rolling Vine)
moves.description: A grapevine with two 1/4 turns added, so you travel while spinning a half turn over 4 counts.

moves.name: Side Together, Side Touch
moves.description: Easier alternative to a grapevine: step side, step together, step side again, touch. Travels the same direction in 4 counts.

moves.name: Coaster Step
moves.description: Step back, step the other foot together, step forward. 3 steps done quickly across 2 counts (back-together-forward).

video.title: Coaster Step Line Dance (how to do)

moves.name: Kick Ball Change
moves.description: Kick one foot forward, step down on the ball of that foot, change your weight back to the other foot. Classic syncopated 2-count step.

moves.name: Jazz Box (Box Step)
moves.description: Cross one foot over the other, step back with the second foot, step the first foot together, cross the second foot over. Traces a box on the floor.

moves.name: Rock Step
moves.description: Step forward (or side) shifting your weight, then rock your weight back to the other foot in place.

video.title: Gail Eaton - Line Dance Basic Steps (Rock Step section)

moves.name: Rocking Chair
moves.description: Two rock steps combined: rock forward, recover back, rock back, recover forward, giving a rocking-chair feel.

moves.name: Sailor Step
moves.description: Cross-step behind, step out with the other foot, step out again with the first foot. A 3-count 'drunken sailor' stagger.

moves.name: Sailor Turn (Turning Sailor)
moves.description: A sailor step with a 1/4 turn added as you finish the out-out.

moves.name: Charleston Step
moves.description: Step forward and touch, touch back, touch toe back, step forward. A swinging, syncopated 4-count step.

moves.name: Monterey Turn
moves.description: Point toe to the side, pivot a 1/4 or 1/2 turn bringing feet together, point the other toe to the side, step together.

moves.name: Hook
moves.description: Bend one knee and cross it in the air in front of (or behind) the other knee. Featured heavily in Slappin' Leather.

moves.name: Heel Jack
moves.description: Tap your heel out in front of you, then bring it back. Often chained into a grapevine.

moves.name: Heel Strut
moves.description: A dramatic 2-count walk: tap your heel out front (heel jack), then drop your full foot down to complete the step.

moves.name: Toe Strut
moves.description: Dig your toe into the floor, then drop your heel down without lifting the toe.

moves.name: Apple Jacks
moves.description: Toe out to the side as the opposite heel swivels in, forming a V shape with your feet.

moves.name: Wizard Step
moves.description: Two lock steps in alternating directions - cross behind with one foot, then the other foot locks behind the opposite way.

moves.name: Lindy Step
moves.description: A side shuffle (chasse) with a back cross rock step added at the end.

moves.name: Twinkle Step
moves.description: Cross one foot over the other, step the other foot to the side, step the first foot together - a 3-count waltz-style step.

moves.name: Weave
moves.description: Cross one foot in front, step the other foot to the side, cross the first foot behind, step the other foot to the side. 4 counts of traveling crosses.

moves.name: Pivot Turn (Step Turn)
moves.description: Step forward, then pivot on the balls of both feet to turn 1/4 or 1/2, shifting weight to the other foot.

moves.name: Scuff / Brush
moves.description: Lift your foot and brush the ball or heel across the floor as you kick it forward.

video.title: Learn the Brush and the Scuff

moves.name: Stomp
moves.description: A single, deliberate foot stomp in place, heel hitting first for a satisfying thud.

moves.name: Touch / Point
moves.description: Touch the toe of one foot to the floor beside or in front of the other, without shifting your weight onto it.

moves.name: Hip Bump
moves.description: Shift weight onto one foot and bump that hip out and back to the beat.

moves.name: Heel Grind
moves.description: Put your heel out in front, toe turned in, then grind/turn the toe out to the side.

moves.name: Side Rock
moves.description: Like a rock step, but sideways: step to the side and shift weight back to the other foot.

moves.name: Shuffle / Triple Step
moves.description: Three quick steps across two beats of music - step, quick step together, step again (1-&-2).

moves.name: Hitch
moves.description: Pull one knee up, usually right after a forward or backward walking step.

moves.name: Chug
moves.description: A small hop forward on one leg while lifting the other knee up.

moves.name: Step
moves.description: Place your foot on the floor and transfer your weight onto it - the most basic building block of every dance.

video.title: How to do a basic Step

moves.name: Swivel
moves.description: With weight on the balls of both feet, swing your heels out, then lean back and swing your toes out.

moves.name: Cross Shuffle
moves.description: A triple step where you cross one foot in front of the other, quick-step the other foot, then cross again.

moves.name: Clap
moves.description: A single clap of the hands on the beat - common as a punctuation move at the end of a phrase.

video.title: Patti Leathers - 10 Common Line Dance Steps

moves.name: YMCA Letter Arms
moves.description: Raise your arms overhead and shape each letter of Y-M-C-A in turn, swapping arm positions on each word.

video.title: YMCA by The Village People - Full Dance Tutorial

moves.name: Macarena Arm Sequence
moves.description: A 16-count loop of arm positions (palms down, palms up, hands to opposite shoulders, hands behind head, hands to hips) followed by a hip shimmy and a quarter turn jump.

video.title: How To Do the Macarena - Ultimate Beginner Step By Step Tutorial

moves.name: Jump Turn (Quarter Turn Hop)
moves.description: A small hop that rotates your body a quarter turn to face the new wall before the sequence repeats.

moves.name: Skate
moves.description: A small diagonal forward step, gliding onto one foot like a skater pushing off, then repeating onto the other foot.

video.title: Line dance steps for beginners - SKATE
